## Querying This Knowledge Base

Open Claude Code in this repo and ask questions like:

- "What were Logan Webb's FanGraphs advanced metrics in 2024?"
- "What does the Statcast glossary say about xERA and FIP?"
- "Which Giants pitchers had the best pitch arsenal metrics in 2024?"
- "What analytical themes define the 2024 Giants pitching staff?"
